summary: Not sure #literacies standards should mix "diverse learners" (referring to cognitive and cultural differences) with equity and culturally responsive education. Too often how PoC get labled as "diverse learners" is so steeped in racism and inequity.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: Not sure #literacies standards should mix "diverse learners" (referring to cognitive and cultural differences) with equity and culturally responsive education. Too often how PoC get labled as "diverse learners" is so steeped in racism and inequity.
